question: Does concurrent execution of independent exact atomic detector dispatches reduce all66 latency at unchanged source/index memory and loading?

parameters.one_factor: MTLComputeCommandEncoder dispatchType concurrent versus serial; exact atomic contributions independent, seed/index initialization in preceding ordered encoders; same mixed-tail/saving8/separated/mixed-only/submission64 in all arms.
parameters.gate: Independent uint16 literal/escape/mixed/signed/inactive contributions first. Full66 A/B/A, seven large/edge/resize/small cases, N5 each. Complete image hashes and immutable prior/reference checks.
parameters.memory: No new source/index/scratch/metadata or persistent outputs. Reuse original allocations; report actual Metal allocation, RSS/compressor/swap.
parameters.timing: Prepared archive source pages unspecified. Warm completed queries; command execution spans and inter-command gaps separate. Not native FPS or cold HDF5.
parameters.default: Internal flag false; no app API/default change.
parameters.command: QUANTEM_TANS_REFILL16_FIXTURE=$ALL66_FIXTURE QUANTEM_TANS_CONCURRENT_DISPATCH=1 QUANTEM_TANS_MIXED_TAILS=1 QUANTEM_TANS_SEPARATE_MIXED=1 QUANTEM_TANS_MIXED_ONLY=1 QUANTEM_TANS_MIXED_SAVINGS_DIVISOR=8 swift test -c release --skip-build --filter TANSSharedRefill16ExperimentTests.testAll66SharedRefill16ABAWhenConfigured
